description: c3844 runtime smoke: start a known-good Combat Simulator match with DY-357 forced through public .pdweapon FileProvider source. This proves a named weapon catalog ID feeds runtime spawn and manifest loading instead of relying on a random roll.

input_sequence.comment: boot, extract/walk .pdweapon archives, seed Combat Simulator config, and fire direct debug match start.
leave enough time for manifest load, Chicago stage load, setupCreateProps, DY-357 source model load, and a few gameplay frames.

required_lines: LOADER\.UNIVERSAL\.OK: kind=weapon scanned=86 registered=86 envelope_failures=0 register_failures=0
manifest: weapon pool enumeration -- added=\d+ filtered=\d+ invalid=0
MODELDEF\.SOURCE: loaded catalog model source type=23 filenum=843 id=base:model_chrdy357
MODELDEF\.SOURCE: loaded catalog model source type=23 filenum=253 id=base:model_taxicab
BONDGUN\.SOURCE: loaded catalog model source filenum=890 id=base:model_dy357_hi path=.*base_model_dy357_hi\.pdmesh::model\.obj
MODASSET\.RENDER: generated source modeldef rendered id=base:model_dy357_hi source=.*base_model_dy357_hi\.pdmesh::model\.obj.*tris=404
BOOT: --debug-force-first-person active: stagenum=0x1d frame=\d+ before=\d+ after=0 frames=900
LOG\.WPN\.DIAG: bgunRender enter player=0 .* R\(wpn=8 visible=1 inuse=1 .* gunctrl_wpn=8 switchto=-1 .* R_gunmodel_def=(?:0x)?0*[1-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]*
